editorial:
Imagine finding love in the most unlikely place, like a construction zone on an old bridge in Paris. You will meet Alex, a circus act who struggles with drinking, and Michele, a painter who is slowly losing her sight. They are both outcasts living on the streets, and their chemistry is electric from the start. The movie feels like a fever dream because it is so colorful and wild, capturing that feeling of young love where everything feels like the end of the world. It is not your typical rom-com; it is more about two broken people trying to hold onto each other while their lives fall apart around them.

You will probably love the acting and the way the movie looks, though the pacing can feel a bit slow and strange at times. If you like stories that are more about feelings than a strict plot, you should definitely give this a try. It is a bit of a wild ride, but the emotion is real.
endingExplained: At the end, Michele has gone completely blind, and Alex tries his best to take care of her. However, the pain of their situation becomes too much. Alex eventually leaves her because he cannot handle the guilt and the sadness of her condition. It is a heartbreaking finish where they do not end up together. You are left with the feeling that their love was beautiful but simply too broken to last.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves tragic love stories and beautiful cinematography.
